title: 6: Linux Developer Workstation
subtitle: Test a realistic IntelliJ → Ubuntu/Linux terminal → system tools → IntelliJ workflow with a stateful virtual Bash environment.

steps.title: Review Student.java before Linux work
steps.why: Linux terminal ki switch avvadaniki mundu developer Java project context ni IntelliJ lo review chestadu. Ee workflow same Java Practice project meeda continue avuthundi.

steps.title: Open the Linux project terminal
steps.why: Production-style Java work lo Linux terminal common. Project root directory lo shell open chesi commands correct project meeda run avuthunnaya ani start chestam.

steps.title: Confirm the current Linux directory
steps.why: pwd current working directory ni print chestundi. Developer expected JavaPractice folder lo unnado idi confirm chestundi.

steps.title: Inspect project files with Linux permissions
steps.why: ls -la hidden files, permissions, owner mariyu project files ni detailed ga chupistundi. Linux deployment/debugging lo ee information chala useful.

steps.title: Verify Java 21 on Linux
steps.why: Linux machine expected Java runtime ni use chesthundha ani java -version tho verify chestam.

steps.title: Check JAVA_HOME
steps.why: Java tools correct JDK ni locate cheyyadaniki JAVA_HOME important. Bash variable expansion kuda ee step lo test avuthundi.

steps.title: Set the application environment
steps.why: export command current Bash session lo environment variable set chestundi. Local, QA, prod laanti runtime profiles ni ila control cheyyadam common.

steps.title: Create build files from the shell
steps.why: mkdir -p mariyu touch commands virtual Linux filesystem ni actually modify chestayi. Playback text matrame kaakunda filesystem state preserve avuthundi.

steps.title: Redirect output into a Linux file
steps.why: > redirection shell output ni file lo write chestundi. Taruvatha cat tho same file content ni read chesi redirection state verify chestam.

steps.title: Filter project text through a pipe
steps.why: Linux lo pipes daily workflow lo important. cat output ni grep ki pampinchi Java text ni filter chestunnam.

steps.title: Make the health script executable
steps.why: Linux permissions executable scripts ni control chestayi. chmod +x tho health-check script run cheyyadaniki permission add chestam.

steps.title: Run the Bash health-check script
steps.why: Shell script execution Linux developer workflow lo common. Previous permission change taruvatha script command execute ayi output generate chestundi.

steps.title: Check the Java service status
steps.why: systemctl status tho deployed service running state ni inspect chestam. Linux production troubleshooting lo idi core command.

steps.title: Restart the Java service
steps.why: Configuration or deployment change taruvatha developer service ni restart cheyyalsi vastundi. Simulator service state ni inactive nundi active ki update chestundi.

steps.title: Inspect recent service logs
steps.why: journalctl service logs ni inspect cheyyadaniki use chestam. Restart event and application logs ni terminal nundi verify cheyyachu.

steps.title: Inspect Linux network addresses
steps.why: ip addr server interfaces mariyu IP addresses ni show chestundi. Connectivity issues troubleshoot cheyyadaniki idi common first check.

steps.title: Inspect listening ports
steps.why: ss -tulpn tho application, PostgreSQL, SSH laanti services e ports meeda listen chestunnayo verify cheyyachu.

steps.title: Check disk usage
steps.why: df -h filesystem usage ni human-readable format lo chupistundi. Disk-full production issues identify cheyyadaniki idi important.

steps.title: Run the Maven test workflow
steps.why: Linux CI/server environment lo Maven commands frequently run chestaru. mvn test deterministic build output tho Java build workflow ni simulate chestundi.

steps.title: Start and stop Spring Boot on Linux
steps.why: mvn spring-boot:run long-running Java process ni start chestundi. Taruvatha Ctrl+C behavior ni separate simulator action tho stop chestam.

steps.title: Stop the running Spring Boot process
steps.why: Terminal lo Ctrl+C long-running foreground process ni terminate chestundi. Linux developer ki idi daily interaction.

steps.title: Return to Student.java after Linux checks
steps.why: Linux verification complete ayyaka developer malli IntelliJ ki return avuthadu. Multi-software timeline continuity preserve avuthundi.
